The sunglasses master/front was rejected: the painted profiles have no sunglasses (two faces in one turn), and dark glasses at night on the quay; every other painted red_black front head (poet.05/06/07) wears them too. invariants.measured_by: shots/skinlab/contracts/prove.mjs in the real Skin Lab (index.html, unmodified; contract extensions interpreted at run time), puppet IK, every frame of T014 T009 T025 T006 T016 T020; full table in contracts/proof/poet/invariants.json
invariants.brad_gap_cm: 0 by construction in puppet mode (every child card is pinned at its socket on the parent card)

weaknesses: Head facing flips in side view when the trial head looks down past vertical (T009 f11-31 lift, T020 coin pick-up): the lab mirrors each profile card from its own forward vector. Machinery (neck clamp), not contract.

Side armhole: the near sleeve now hangs from the drawn armhole (fix.sockets), which covers it while the arm hangs (T014 1%, T009 mean 3%, max 12%); with the arm raised forward the lower oval shows (T016 kneel mean 21%, max 30%; T020 max 33%). The shoulder therefore sits ~10 cm behind the skeleton shoulder in side view (socket drift up to ~24 cm).

Grip cards come from two other red_black sheets (hands sheet for side, poet.14 parts for the fists): same costume and painter, not the body sheets. The fists are lower resolution (80x113 px) than the body cards.

The trial prop positions sit ~20-25 cm from the drawn hold point (the bank stores the prop centre and the cards miss the skeleton wrist by up to ~12-18 cm); the proof draws the prop at the hand, so the prop travels with the hand.
Front face from the black_tshirt sheet is smoother in finish than the master profile/back heads; trimmed 6 px for the fringe.

Sockets are bound per view and facing (bind_per_view); stacking, grips, erase, trim, sockets, ears and hold are contract fields that index.html does not read: prove.mjs interprets them; puppet-core.js must implement them for the film.
No three-quarter view in the lab: the side/front swap lands where the torso crosses the ~57 degree threshold, not on a chosen pose.
